def format_tool(name, duration, success):
    return f"{name}: {duration:.2f}s (success={success})"

def normalize_record(record: dict, prefix="tool-") -> dict:
    result = record.copy()
    result["id"] = prefix + record["id"].strip()
    result["name"] = record["name"].strip().lower()
    return result

def add_tag(record: dict, tag: str, tags=None) -> dict:
    source = record.get("tags", []) if tags is None else tags
    copied_tags = list(source)
    copied_tags.append(tag)
    result = record.copy()
    result["tags"] = copied_tags
    return result

def prepare_records(records: list, prefix="tool-") -> list:
    result = []
    for record in records:
        normalized = normalize_record(record, prefix=prefix)
        result.append(add_tag(normalized, "reviewed"))
    return result
